Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform
Initech is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build the services that move money for 40,000 merchants.

What you will do
- Design and run backend services in Python and Java on AWS.
- Own data stores in PostgreSQL and Redis, and event streams on Kafka.
- Ship containers with Docker and Kubernetes through a CI/CD pipeline.
- Share on-call for the services your team owns and improve their reliability.
- Feed reporting data into Redshift for finance and analytics partners.

What you bring
- 6+ years of backend engineering experience in production systems.
- Strong Python skills and solid SQL.
- Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis and PostgreSQL.
- Comfort with CI/CD and being on-call.

Nice to have
- GitHub Actions workflows.
- Java services at scale.
- Terraform for infrastructure as code.
